body: 8 years ago today, Kanye West sent a warning to Drake @champagnepapi after rumors spread he slept with Kim Kardashian & rapped about it on “In My Feelings” (2018) “If I had a girlfriend, her name was Rinita, and then you was married to Rihanna? I wouldn’t make no song called Riri…” kanyewest drake ye.
